title: HJ/CO/BTN facing a middle raise
keyIdea: A LJ/HJ open is wider than an early open. 3-bet more strong hands for value, and call with pairs, suited broadways and connectors.

actions.call: TT-44, AJs-ATs, KQs-KTs, QJs-QTs, JTs, T9s, 98s, AJo, KQo

notes.A5s: A classic bluff raise: the ace blocks AA/AK, and it can still make a straight or the nut flush.
